title: Shaker panelling along a loft bedroom wall
summary: A batten grid along the long wall of a loft bedroom, six panels across under the old dado rail, with the last frame cut to follow the slope of the roof.
intro: A loft bedroom with one long plain wall under a dado rail. I set it out in my Workshop Tools app first: six panels across a 4105 mm wall, 1000 mm high, in 69 mm MDF battens. The grid sits on the skirting and runs up under the dado rail, and at the end where the roof comes down the top rail turns and follows the slope. The battens are left bare, ready for the decorator.

cover.alt: MDF batten panelling along a loft bedroom wall, six panels across, the last one cut to the slope by the roof window

after.alt: The same wall after: six panels of MDF battens under the dado rail

steps.title: A plain wall under a dado rail
steps.text: The long wall of a loft bedroom: painted plaster under a dado rail, with the roof sloping down at the right hand end by the roof window.

image.alt: The plain wall under the dado rail, with the roof sloping down at the far end

steps.title: Set out in my app
steps.text: I put the wall into the batten grid in my free Workshop Tools app: 4105 mm wide, 1000 mm high, 69 mm battens, six panels across. It gave openings of 603.7 x 862, where each upright goes, and seven 2440 lengths to buy.

image.alt: The Workshop Tools app showing 6 panels across, openings 603.7 x 862 and where each upright goes

steps.title: Battens cut
steps.text: Two rails run the whole width, joined over an upright, and seven uprights at 862 mm fit between them. All cut from MDF strips.

image.alt: MDF battens cut to length on the floor

steps.title: Set up in the room
steps.text: Room ready: the mitre saw set up and the battens laid out on the floor.

image.alt: The mitre saw and the battens set up in the room

steps.title: Cut to the slope
steps.text: At the far end the roof comes down into the wall, so the top rail turns and runs along the slope, and the last upright is cut short to meet it.

image.alt: The last frame by the roof window, its top rail running along the slope

steps.title: Ready for the decorator
steps.text: The grid sits on the skirting and finishes under the old dado rail. The battens are left bare, ready for the decorator.

image.alt: The finished wall from the bed, six panels across

model3d.text: The wall drawn in 3D to the real sizes from my Workshop Tools app: 4105 mm wide, 1000 mm high, 69 mm battens and six openings of 603.7 x 862.
